latestAction.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on National Parks. Hearings held.

summary.text: This bill makes the law of the state in which a National Park System unit is located applicable to the use of motor vehicles (including off-highway vehicles) on roads within a system unit.

title: A bill to amend title 54, United States Code, to provide that State law shall apply to the use of motor vehicles on roads within a System unit.
